```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "user": ["alice", "bob", "charlie", "david", "eve"],
    "amount": [50, 150, 75, 200, 120]
})

# Build deferred query using lazy evaluation
lazy_query = df.lazy().filter(pl.col("amount") > 100).select("user")

# Materialize the result eagerly
result = lazy_query.collect()

print(result)
```
